Source-assisted reading of F-3wqe (Orselina-Locarno, Biblioteca Madonna del Sasso, MdS 58 Ba 27). Made with the candidate text in view for the lower strip; all four lines of the lower strip and all seven lines of the upper strip were reread on enlarged crops of the image by a research reader. Square brackets mark what is cut away or damaged; round brackets resolve abbreviations; a question mark marks a doubtful reading. Nothing inside square brackets was read.

Canvas 2 (mds_58Ba27_phyb, 5407 x 7982), lower strip (Frammento 3), native box 3100,4000,4290,5250. Middles of four consecutive verses, each line cut at both ends. Eberhard of Bethune, Graecismus XIX 118-121.
